column1: # jobleft credentials: licences and certifications that postings ask for, with the words they are written in.
# Source: written new for jobleft by the match lane (2026-09-25). First-party data; no third-party list was copied.
# Licence: same as the jobleft project. Names are the public names of licences and certifications.
# Format: id | name | kind | families | aliases | title phrases that suggest it
#   * kind: licence (a state or government licence) or cert (a certification).
#   * aliases: how postings and profiles write it. A leading = means the letters must match in case ("CPA").
#     A trailing @ctx needs a context (see src/taxonomy.ts): @health, @acct, @weld, @drive.
#   * title phrases: a past role with this title suggests the person holds it. This never counts as holding it: the
#     score shows "not in your profile" and gives half credit in the Skills part only.
